QUOTE: `ExternalBridge::accept_loop` | `ExternalBridge::start` | Polls the listen socket every 500 ms, checks peer uid, and spawns one thread per client. | Per-client `serve_client` thread | `accept_loop` | Serves one external MCP client.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the accept loop thread (started in start) spawns one serve_client thread per client, which is the two-level structure.
